outcome: An active user's session is extended before it expires, so they are not logged out mid-session.

acceptance_criteria.text: Refreshing a session that exists and is still valid extends it.

expected_verification.assertion: refreshing a live session returns true

acceptance_criteria.text: Refreshing a session that has already expired does not extend it and does not restore access.

expected_verification.assertion: refreshing a session past its expiry returns false and the session stays unreadable
